bootstrap_reproduction.statistic: row-pooled mean of per-row loss_advantage over a race-resampled corpus: resample 8 races with replacement (seed 987654321), pool ALL rows of picked races, take the row mean. This is NOT the race-macro mean of per-race advantages, which is why the bootstrap mean (-0.151) differs from the race-macro mean advantage (-0.233): races contribute proportional to their row counts under resampling.

definition: advantage = ll_log - ll_mc2 per driver-row (binary WIN log loss, eps 1e-15 evaluation-only clipping). advantage > 0 => MC2 lower loss (MC2 better). advantage < 0 => Logistic lower loss (Logistic better). Per-race advantage = row mean of advantage within the race.

explanation: All three statements are mutually consistent once the aggregation/statistic is exact. Per-race advantages show Logistic strictly better in 7/8 races (only 2023-r05-R favors MC2, +0.0128). The bootstrap mean (-0.151) is NEGATIVE, i.e. favors Logistic under the stated sign convention, and its CI barely excludes zero on the Logistic side. The report sentence 'MC2 better in 7/8 races' is a wording/label error repeating the sign-swapped log_better/mc2_better counter labels, not an empirical contradiction. The 'race-macro reverses the ranking' exploratory sentence is likewise incorrect: race-macro mean advantage is -0.233 (Logistic better), same direction as pooled (-0.136 pooled-mean difference). There is no pooled-vs-macro ranking reversal; the outlier inflates the pooled MC2 mean but does not flip either ranking.
gate_impact: NONE. COMPLEMENTARITY requires each mechanism strictly better in >=1 race AND both per-row advantage signs present. method: EXISTING D artifacts only: results/v3/v3_8d/per_row_records.json (277 rows) + results/v3/v3_8d/historical_evaluation.json + frozen scripts/v3_8d_run.py implementation. Recomputed per-row binary log loss with the identical eps=1e-15 evaluation-only clipping, re-derived per-race means, re-derived the race-macro mean, and re-executed the frozen bootstrap procedure verbatim (seed 987654321, B=2000, race resample + row-pooled mean). root_cause: scripts/v3_8d_run.py lines 457-460: per_race_adv = mean_ll_log - mean_ll_mc2 (so v > 0 means MC2 better), but log_better counts v > 0 and mc2_better counts v < 0. The two counter labels are sign-swapped relative to the preregistered loss_advantage definition (evaluation_protocol.json scoring.loss_advantage: 'loss_logistic - loss_mc2; positive = MC2 lower loss'). historical_evaluation.json gate_inputs therefore stores log_better=1 / mc2_better=7 when the per-race table in the same artifact shows Logistic lower loss in 7 races. The D report prose repeated the swapped labels.
